# Psalm 88 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 88:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-YHWH God-of my-salvation, by-day I-cry-out, in-the-night before-you.
- **LOGOS:** O LORD, God of my salvation, I cry out day and night before you.
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, God who saves me — I've been crying out to you day and night.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 88:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Let-come before-you my-prayer; incline your-ear to-my-cry.
- **LOGOS:** Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry!
- **PNEUMA:** Please let my prayer reach you! Turn your ear toward my cries.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 88:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For is-full of-troubles my-soul, and-my-life to-Sheol has-drawn-near.
- **LOGOS:** For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
- **PNEUMA:** My soul is drowning in trouble, and my life is sliding toward the grave.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 88:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-have-put-me in-pit lowest, in-dark-places, in-the-depths.
- **LOGOS:** You have put me in the depths of the pit, in the regions dark and deep.
- **PNEUMA:** You've thrown me into the deepest, darkest pit.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 88:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-have-removed my-acquaintances from-me; you-have-made-me an-abomination to-them; shut-in and-not I-can-go-out.
- **LOGOS:** You have caused my companions to shun me; you have made me a horror to them. I am shut in so that I cannot escape;
- **PNEUMA:** You've driven all my friends away from me; you've made me repulsive to them. I'm trapped with no way out.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 88:12 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Will-be-declared in-the-grave your-steadfast-love? Your-faithfulness in-Abaddon?
- **LOGOS:** Is your steadfast love declared in the grave, or your faithfulness in Abaddon?
- **PNEUMA:** Does anyone in the grave talk about your faithful love? Does anyone in the place of destruction mention your reliability?

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
